scope: Shared nuisance construction for realized primary module cohorts. This definition reads no ecological response coefficient and authorizes no fit by itself.

calendar.date_source: Exact observed_on day already frozen by v3_full_source_observation_annotations_v1.
calendar.phase_definition: Use the annotation phase 2*pi*(DOY-1)/days_in_observed_year; do not recompute a 365-day approximation.
calendar.pre_1980_rule: Retain exact-day observations before 1980. Observation year is a nuisance term; CHELSA 1981-2010 values are climatological month/context exposures, not weather in the observation year.
calendar.hemisphere_rule: The recovered native ecological source is northern-only. south_indicator, south_sin and south_cos are therefore structurally constant/aliased and are not supplied to the v3 primary model. Preserve them in source annotations for audit; do not add/remove hemisphere interactions later using trait associations.

imaging.support: Use endpoint/module-matched quality summaries from the exact same operational heads/images/observation rows as the response module.
imaging.size_source: head_min_dimension_px aggregated as the module-matched observation quality field size
imaging.sharpness_source: head_laplacian_variance aggregated as the module-matched observation quality field sharpness
imaging.missingness: No imputation and no borrowing quality values from another endpoint/module. A realized module row lacking its matched size or sharpness is non-eligible for that module fit but remains in source/measurement coverage accounting.
imaging.reason_not_used: Not consistently available across the full source and not required for the predeclared minimal imaging adjustment.

spatial.handling: Supply all eight predeclared columns. The joint solver may orthogonalize redundant nuisance span without deleting environmental predictors; global exposure aliasing or insufficient residual rank is non-estimable, not permission for outcome-driven term deletion.

intercept: No explicit intercept in this matrix. Within fitting removes taxon intercepts; among fitting adds its own intercept to matched taxon summaries.
realized_model_diagnostics: For each module, report exact row/taxon membership, nuisance rank, residual degrees of freedom, environmental rank/condition/VIF and reasons for non-eligibility before interpreting coefficients.
